caption: The drawing depicts two views of a doll with pale blonde hair, positioned against a plain, light-colored background. On the left, the doll is sitting and dressed in a light gray dress with lace cuffs and a lace-trimmed collar, along with a long, striped cape that is maroon with yellow stripes and lined in light fabric. The doll also wears a white lace cap on its head. Its face has clearly defined features, including eyes, a nose, and a mouth. On the right, the same doll is shown standing and viewed from the back, undressed except for a form-fitting, pale body suit that covers its entire body. The standing figure shows the doll's articulated joints at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. The overall composition is simple, with both figures spaced apart and ample negative space around them. The primary colors used are pale gray, maroon, yellow, light beige, and white.
title: Doll
